relationship_to_v2: FRESH preregistration, not an amendment. v2's execution conditions are false: the server's prefix cache was not crediting when its trials ran, and has since been fixed. v2 is retained unedited as the record of what ran under the broken cache.

what_changed.only_difference_from_v2: the server. The task, prompts, skill body, sandbox recipe, verifier, loop analyser, 5,400 s cap, arm order and 3-trials-per-arm are all unchanged and hash-pinned.
what_changed.the_fix: The operator found and fixed a cache-killing bug: a Claude Code marker whose value changes every turn sat inside the cached prefix, so the prefix differed each turn and the cache missed entirely. Their measurement on a 4,000-token prefix: 16.4/16.4/16.2 s before, 16.4/0.11/0.11 s after -- 149x.
what_changed.mechanism_for_this_harness_not_establish: Zero occurrences of `total_tokens` or `tokens left` were found in any deep request captured from `claude --print` across two logging-proxy sessions. So that specific marker does not appear in this harness's request shape. The EFFECT is established for v2's trials by arithmetic (see prediction below); the mechanism for this shape is not, and neither the marker nor an alternative is asserted.

not_poolable.with_v2_trials: The two completed v2 trials (skill-1, noskill-1) ran under the broken cache and MUST NOT be pooled with anything run here, compared as if the condition were constant, or used to revise these results. Nor the reverse.
not_poolable.with_m7_or_m8: Unchanged from v2: different serving implementation, different advertised model, explicitly 4-bit quantization, speculative decoding, and Codex cannot reach this backend at all so those harnesses are unrunnable as written.

prediction_on_record_before_the_trials.statement: If the cache holds, the same task projects to ~1,468 s -- 28% of the 5,400 s cap.
prediction_on_record_before_the_trials.derivation: delta-only prefill of skill-1's 74,531 tokens of context growth at 311 tok/s = 240 s, plus decode of 20,264 output tokens at the operator's deep-reasoning rate of 16.5 tok/s = 1,228 s.
prediction_on_record_before_the_trials.what_it_is_and_is_not: A projection from ONE broken-cache trial's own token record, not a forecast of what any new trial will do. Turn count, tool use and reasoning volume all vary freely. It is recorded so it can be wrong in public.
prediction_on_record_before_the_trials.how_it_will_be_judged: Reported against each completed trial's elapsed time, without adjustment. A trial that terminates cleanly well inside the cap corroborates it; trials that again hit 5,400 s falsify it and mean the cache was not the dominant cost after all.

in_flight_cache_verification.why_the_proposed_identity_check_was_repl: The coordinator proposed using `sum(per-turn contexts) == input_tokens total` as the in-flight signal. Measured against both cache states, it does not discriminate: broken-cache trial and working-cache bench both report usage keys ['input_tokens','output_tokens'], both report input_tokens as the FULL context, and both omit cache_read_input_tokens entirely. The identity is a reporting artifact that holds either way. It was decisive for skill-1 only in combination with the wall clock.
in_flight_cache_verification.what_is_used_instead: wall clock against the full-recompute projection
in_flight_cache_verification.prefill_rate_justification: 311 tok/s is the operator's spec (32k in 102.9 s); this harness's own novel-prefix measurement gave 267 tok/s, so the two agree to within their spread.
in_flight_cache_verification.calibration: skill-1 under the broken cache scores 1.323. Validated before freezing: the check flags it correctly, and the truncated-tail detector produces no false positive on either completed v2 trial.
in_flight_cache_verification.enforcement: Run after every trial. The FIRST cache_NOT_credited stops the series (exit 67), because every subsequent trial would measure the old condition and cost 90 minutes to do it.

truncated_tail_watch.symptom: response tails cut unnaturally -- a sentence ending mid-way, a code block left unclosed. Backend-specific, patched locally, and the patch can be lost SILENTLY on a package update.
truncated_tail_watch.detector: scripts/detect_truncated_tail.py, run on every trial: odd ``` fence count, or a non-empty tail ending without terminal punctuation, checked on the final result text, the last assistant text block and the last thinking block. Conservative -- a turn ending in a tool call has no text and is not flagged.
truncated_tail_watch.handling: A hit STOPS the series (exit 68). No retry. Record the time the symptom was noticed, the approximate token count of the request, and the client.
truncated_tail_watch.correspondence_recorded_not_asserted: Symptomatically matches the upstream_silent_truncation class defined on LM Studio, and Ollama's own variant. Three serving implementations, same weights family. No common cause asserted.

arms.manipulated_variable: one paragraph naming the skill, plus the skill file present in the checkout; mechanically verified as the only prompt delta

task.acceptance_test_never_in_the_agent_tree: installed only by the verifier, into a fresh tree built from the pinned revision into which only rust.rs is copied

deliberately_NOT_changed.syn_api_surface: NOT given to either arm. Weakened as a hypothesis: noskill-1 reached a change that compiles and passes 120/120 without it.
deliberately_NOT_changed.forced_exploration_to_implementation_tra: NOT added. noskill-1 made the transition unaided; the clock stopped it, not indecision.
deliberately_NOT_changed.why_both_are_held: Changing the task and the condition at once would leave any difference unattributable. This run isolates the condition.

backend_identity_gate.note: gates on the /v1/models listing hash, never on the echoed response.model, which passed through an entire backend swap

primary_output_is_descriptive.statement: Per-trial records: the three verdicts, what the loop actually did, and the cache-credit ratio. NOT an arm comparison.
primary_output_is_descriptive.comparative_claims: Nothing is ever ACCEPTED. Complete separation (3/3 versus 0/3) on a verdict axis is reported as SUGGESTIVE only; anything less is noise, stated in advance.

half_edited_tree_rule.rule: How the loop ended is classified BEFORE its code is looked at, and that classification wins. exit 124 -> loop_incomplete_timeout; other non-zero -> loop_incomplete_error. A half-edited tree that does not compile is reported as loop_incomplete_*, never as does_not_compile. Excluded from compiles/tests_pass tallies, with the exclusion and its count reported.
half_edited_tree_rule.note_from_v2: noskill-1 was loop_incomplete_timeout yet its code compiled and passed 120/120. The rule stands, and the code state is reported alongside it rather than hidden by it.

isolation.benchmarks_removed: the pinned archive carries benchmarks/m7-head-local-v1; deleted from every working copy
isolation.credentials: fresh mode-700 CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR per trial, no credentials inside, dummy API key

stopping_rules: One request in flight at any time.
No retry of any trial, for any reason.
Any upstream failure stops the series immediately. Record time, approximate token count, client, and how many trials of each arm completed.
A backend identity gate failure stops the series (exit 66).
The first cache_NOT_credited stops the series (exit 67).
A truncated-tail signature stops the series (exit 68).
Per-trial wall-clock cap 5,400 s; hitting it is loop_incomplete_timeout and does not by itself stop the series.
Maximum 6 trials. A trial lost upstream is excluded and NOT replaced.
Every halt uses scripts/halt.sh, whose verification is an untruncated count and which exits non-zero if anything survives.
preservation: Each trial is copied into the repository as it completes, never batched. That rule has already prevented one loss in this program.
